notes: Five prompts should route to this skill and five are adjacent but out of scope, so both over-triggering and under-triggering are measurable.
Two of the out-of-scope probes are the cases the skill's 'When NOT to use this' section names explicitly: a script that must run under POSIX sh, and shell built inside another language.
A probe is correct when the skill fired and was expected to, or did not fire and was not expected to.

prompts.prompt: Write a script that archives /etc into a tarball on the backup share and keeps the last seven copies.
Our deploy script builds the ssh command by interpolating the branch name into a string. Review it before we hand it to CI.
The nightly cron script leaves its temporary directory behind whenever a step fails halfway. Fix the cleanup.
Add argument parsing to the container entrypoint script so it accepts a --config path and passes the rest through.
The provisioning script keeps the database password in a variable and hands it to mysql on the command line. Sort that out.
This has to run as a Debian maintainer script under dash, so keep it POSIX sh with no bashisms.
Our Python code calls subprocess with shell=True and a formatted string. Rewrite that call.
Explain how job control works in an interactive bash session. No code changes needed.
Add a step to the GitHub Actions workflow that uploads the build artifact after the tests pass.
Our Ansible role uses the shell module to create an account. Replace it with the user module.
